ReportRequestV2.description: Explicit mappings. Optional outputs must be selected outputs, with at least one required output. Every output must have a mapping; each required output needs a required delivery. Required deliveries cannot depend on optional outputs. Duplicate destination/format pairs and physical targets are rejected. Backend enforces cross-field rules.

jrxml.description: UTF-8 standalone JasperReports 7 JRXML, maximum 32768 bytes. Full JSON request maximum 65536 bytes.

rows.description: Maximum 32768 canonical UTF-8 bytes; empty data is rejected. Values must have their declared JSON types.
